description: This file defines a React client-side component 'InvoiceDetailClient' that manages viewing and editing invoice details within a shop management system. It includes functions for formatting currency and dates, loads invoice data via API calls, and renders a UI with tabs for Overview and Edit modes, including form validation and update logic.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string, defaults to USD.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string into a locale date string, or returns '-' if invalid.

methods.name: toDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string into 'yyyy-mm-dd' format suitable for date input fields.

methods.name: fromDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts a 'yyyy-mm-dd' date string into an ISO date string.

methods.name: statusVariant
methods.description: Returns a variant string based on invoice status to determine badge style.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the invoice edit form data, returning errors for invalid fields.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles form submission, performing validation, optimistic update, API call for save, and error handling.
